exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Online Habits Survey
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Hi Anna, I'm doing a survey on online habits. How much time do you spend online every day?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: It depends, but usually about two hours, mostly after school.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: And what do you usually do online?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I chat with my friends and stream music. Sometimes I write a blog post.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Interesting. Why do you use the Internet so much?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Mainly to keep in touch with friends who live far away. It makes me feel less lonely.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: That's a great reason. Do you ever worry about your privacy?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I never give out my home address, and I use a strong password for every account.

exercises.translation_cn: Sam 在做网上习惯调查;Anna 每天约上网两小时,多在放学后;她常和朋友聊天、流播音乐,有时写博客;主要为了和远方朋友保持联系、减少孤独;她也注意隐私,从不透露家庭住址,每个账户都用强密码。

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 What the Internet Does for Us
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: The Internet has made our daily lives far more convenient.
When we shop, we no longer need to wait in line or carry cash.
We can get the newest information from large databases in seconds.
We can also download software, documents, and images whenever we need them.
Most of all, it helps people who live far apart feel close to one another.
exercises.translation_cn: 互联网让日常生活方便许多;购物时不再需要排队或带现金;几秒内就能从大型数据库获取最新信息;需要时随时能下载软件、文档和图片;最重要的是,它让相隔遥远的人感到亲近。

options: Wait in line or carry cash.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Looking for a Fitness App
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Xiao Bo
transcript.text: Laura, I'm looking for an app to help me get in shape. Any ideas?

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Sure. This one keeps track of every step you take during the day.

transcript.speaker: Xiao Bo
transcript.text: That sounds good. I imagine it would help me walk more.

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: It might. And this second app can even help you make a fitness plan.

transcript.speaker: Xiao Bo
transcript.text: Great! What about you? What kind of app do you want?

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: I'd like one that helps me get discounts when I shop online.

transcript.speaker: Xiao Bo
transcript.text: I guess you could save a little money with that. Have you found one yet?

transcript.speaker: Laura
transcript.text: Not yet. But before I download anything, I always read what other users say.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 A Few Rules for Staying Safe
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here are a few simple rules for staying safe online.
If a site makes you feel uncomfortable, leave it at once and click nothing.
Never give out your home address or phone number to people you don't know.
Someone could use that information to steal your identity.
And remember, the more polite you are, the less likely you are to be attacked.
exercises.translation_cn: 几条简单的上网安全规则:如果某网站让你不舒服,立刻离开、什么也别点;绝不要把家庭住址或电话给不认识的人;有人可能用这些信息盗用你的身份;记住,你越有礼貌,就越不容易被攻击。

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Setting Up New Software
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: My phone is so slow these days. Can you help me, dear?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Of course. Let's download some new software to clean it up.

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: Is it safe? I worry about these things.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Don't worry. I'm using a website we're familiar with. Now it asks you to choose a password.

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: What kind of password should I choose?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: A strong one, not your name or birthday. Now press this button to start.

transcript.speaker: Mum
transcript.text: All right. Oh, it says the software has been downloaded already!

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Perfect. Let's open it. Look, your phone is running much faster now.

exercises.translation_cn: 妈妈手机很慢请 Tom 帮忙;Tom 提议下载新软件清理;妈妈担心是否安全;Tom 说用的是熟悉的网站,要她设个密码;妈妈问设什么样的;Tom 说要强密码,别用名字或生日,然后按按钮开始;很快软件就下载好了;打开后手机快了很多。

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 A Tip on Social Media
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone who uses social media.
It is easy to spend too much time checking messages and photos.
Try to turn off your apps for an hour before you go to bed.
This will help you sleep better and feel calmer the next day.
Remember, you control the Internet; the Internet should not control you.
exercises.translation_cn: 给使用社交媒体的人一个小贴士:很容易花太多时间查看消息和照片;试着睡前一小时关掉应用;这能帮你睡得更好、第二天更平静;记住,是你控制互联网,而不该是互联网控制你。
